Which, I mean, I walked upon. It is ycleped thy park. Then for the place, where? lines.plainText: This is not so well as I looked for but the best that ever I heard

lines.text: Ay, the best for the worst. But, sirrah, what say you to this?
lines.plainText: Ay the best for the worst But sirrah what say you to this

lines.text: Sir, I confess the wench.
lines.plainText: Sir I confess the wench

lines.text: Did you hear the proclamation?
lines.plainText: Did you hear the proclamation

lines.text: I do confess much of the hearing it, but little of the marking of it.
lines.plainText: I do confess much of the hearing it but little of the marking of it

lines.text: It was proclaimed a year's imprisonment to be taken with a wench.
lines.plainText: It was proclaimed a year's imprisonment to be taken with a wench

lines.text: I was taken with none, sir. I was taken with a damsel.
lines.plainText: I was taken with none sir I was taken with a damsel

lines.text: Well, it was proclaimed "damsel".
lines.plainText: Well it was proclaimed damsel

lines.text: This was no damsel neither, sir; she was a virgin.
lines.plainText: This was no damsel neither sir she was a virgin

lines.text: It is so varied too, for it was proclaimed "virgin".
lines.plainText: It is so varied too for it was proclaimed virgin

lines.text: If it were, I deny her virginity. I was taken with a maid.
lines.plainText: If it were I deny her virginity I was taken with a maid

lines.text: This maid will not serve your turn, sir.
lines.plainText: This maid will not serve your turn sir

lines.text: This maid will serve my turn, sir.
lines.plainText: This maid will serve my turn sir

lines.text: Sir, I will pronounce your sentence: you shall fast a week with bran and water.
lines.plainText: Sir I will pronounce your sentence you shall fast a week with bran and water

lines.text: I had rather pray a month with mutton and porridge.
lines.plainText: I had rather pray a month with mutton and porridge

lines.text: And Don Armado shall be your keeper.
lines.plainText: And Don Armado shall be your keeper

lines.text: My Lord Berowne, see him delivered o'er;
lines.plainText: My Lord Berowne see him delivered o'er

lines.text: And go we, lords, to put in practice that
lines.plainText: And go we lords to put in practice that

lines.text: Which each to other hath so strongly sworn.
lines.plainText: Which each to other hath so strongly sworn

lines.text: I'll lay my head to any good man's hat
lines.plainText: I'll lay my head to any good man's hat

lines.text: These oaths and laws will prove an idle scorn.
lines.plainText: These oaths and laws will prove an idle scorn

lines.text: Sirrah, come on.
lines.plainText: Sirrah come on

lines.text: I suffer for the truth, sir; for true it is I was taken with Jaquenetta, and Jaquenetta is a true girl. And therefore welcome the sour cup of prosperity! Affliction may one day smile again, and till then, sit thee down, sorrow.
